entries.title: What is a memorial glass stone?
entries.text: It is a keepsake material made by fusing cremation ash into a glass-like form. Before ordering, review the process, material notes, and provider credentials.

entries.title: How should a hair keepsake necklace be stored?
entries.text: Hair keepsakes rely on dry, sealed storage. Avoid wearing them while bathing or swimming, and store them away from heat and direct sunlight.

entries.title: Is grief after losing a pet normal?
entries.text: Yes. Sadness, guilt, emptiness, and fatigue are all common grief responses after losing a beloved companion.

entries.title: How can I explain a pet loss to a child?
entries.text: Use gentle and direct words, avoid confusing phrases like “went to sleep,” and let the child share feelings at their own pace.

entries.title: What cremation options are common?
entries.text: Private cremation usually returns ashes, while communal cremation usually does not. Ask for a clear process before deciding.

entries.title: What does “Rainbow Bridge” mean?
entries.text: Rainbow Bridge is a comforting image many people use to speak about remembrance, reunion, and hope after a pet passes away.

entries.title: When should I sort my pet’s belongings?
entries.text: There is no rush. You can store everything first and come back later when you feel ready to choose what to keep.

entries.title: What is grief counseling?
entries.text: Grief counseling offers professional support for coping with loss. It can help when sorrow keeps affecting sleep, work, or daily life.
